nodes.title: SG-5.2 Frozen-ids reader on the contribution file store
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/contribution/store.go has FileStore (Save, Get, ListByRound) and export_source.go declares ExportSource with ListByRound and a compile-time assertion for *FileStore. A closed round's frozen contribution list lives in worlds/<world>/rounds/<round-lowercase>/snapshot.yaml (round.Snapshot, entries with id). Desired behavior: FileStore reads that file, returns the frozen contribution ids, returns ErrNotFound cleanly when no snapshot exists, and validates world and round ids. Why: the devion workseed handoff export needs only frozen contributions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a round dir with snapshot.yaml listing ids a and b, when FrozenIDs(ctx, world, round) is called, then it returns [a b] in snapshot order
- Given a round with no snapshot.yaml, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns an error satisfying errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound)
- Given a world or round id that is not a safe path segment, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns an error and reads no file
- Given the contribution package, when it compiles, then *FileStore is asserted to implement ExportSource including FrozenIDs


## Scope
- In scope: FileStore.FrozenIDs
- In scope: ExportSource interface method FrozenIDs
- Out of scope: Exporter assembling the JSON
- Out of scope: Any worker or execution code
- Out of scope: Changing snapshot writing in the round package
- Preserve: Existing Save, Get, ListByRound, ListByPlayer behavior
- Preserve: Export and ExportContribution JSON types
- Preserve: Snapshot file format in internal/round/snapshot.go


## Technical constraints
- Go backend; use gopkg.in/yaml.v3 already used by the round package
- Use safepath.Segment for id validation like ListByRound
- Round dir uses strings.ToLower(roundID)


## Definition of done
- FrozenIDs implemented and compiles
- ExportSource asserted on *FileStore
- Unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · FileStore.FrozenIDs reads snapshot.yaml and validates ids
nodes.body:
FileStore gains FrozenIDs(ctx, worldID, roundID) ([]string, error) reading worlds/<world>/rounds/<lower round>/snapshot.yaml and returning each contribution entry id in file order. A missing file maps to ErrNotFound; unsafe ids are rejected before any filesystem access.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given snapshot.yaml with contributions ids a and b, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns [a b]
- Given no snapshot.yaml, when FrozenIDs is called, then errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) is true
- Given worldID '../x' or roundID 'a/b', when FrozenIDs is called, then an error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: store.go FrozenIDs
- Out of scope: Exporter
- Preserve: ListByRound behavior


## Technical constraints
- Decode with a local struct holding contributions[].id to avoid importing round


## Definition of done
- Method implemented per acceptance criteria

nodes.title: REQ · ExportSource declares FrozenIDs and FileStore is asserted to implement it
nodes.body:
Extend the ExportSource interface in export_source.go with FrozenIDs so the export reads only frozen ids, and keep the var _ ExportSource = (*FileStore)(nil) assertion so the build fails if FileStore lacks it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given ExportSource, when inspected, then it declares ListByRound and FrozenIDs
- Given the package, when compiled, then the assertion that *FileStore implements ExportSource passes
- Given the fake source in tests, when it implements both methods, then it is usable as an ExportSource


## Scope
- In scope: export_source.go interface
- Out of scope: Exporter logic
- Preserve: export.go types
- Preserve: No worker/execution imports in export files


## Technical constraints
- export_source.go must not import worker or execution packages


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Interface extended; assertion retained


## Clarifying questions
- None
